mapper.select:
SELECT t.*, mbw.name AS workshop_name, mbp.name AS process_name, mbp.product_type FROM ( SELECT workshop_id, process_id, team_leader_name, SUM(IFNULL(yield_quantity, 0)) AS total_quantity FROM mes_production_wage WHERE bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND bool_confirm = FALSE
AND date_format(inbound_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(#{selectedDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(inbound_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(#{selectedDate}, '%Y-%m')
AND date_format(inbound_time, '%Y') = date_format(#{selectedDate}, '%Y')
AND workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND process_id = #{processId}
GROUP BY workshop_id, process_id, team_leader_name ) t LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop mbw ON mbw.id = t.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON t.process_id = mbp.id

SELECT mpw.*, cp.serial_number AS project_serial_number, cp.name AS project_name, pm.name AS monomer_name, pa.name AS area_name,
type.classification_name AS type_name,
type.name AS type_name,
ifnull(mpw.yield_quantity, 0) as quantity FROM mes_production_wage mpw LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = mpw.project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.id = mpw.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area pa ON pa.id = mpw.area_id
LEFT JOIN sys_structure_classification type ON type.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND type.id = mpw.product_class_id
LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_config type ON type.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND type.id = mpw.product_class_id
LEFT JOIN sys_steel_classification type ON type.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND type.id = mpw.product_class_id
WHERE mpw.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mpw.bool_confirm = FALSE AND mpw.workshop_id = #{workshopId} AND mpw.process_id = #{processId} AND mpw.team_leader_name = #{teamLeaderName} AND mpw.product_process_type = #{productType}
AND date_format(mpw.inbound_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(#{selectedDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(mpw.inbound_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(#{selectedDate}, '%Y-%m')
AND date_format(mpw.inbound_time, '%Y') = date_format(#{selectedDate}, '%Y')
and (cp.name like #{projectNameLike} or cp.serial_number like #{projectNameLike})
and mpw.product_serial_number like #{productSerialNumberLike}

SELECT t1.workshop_id, t1.process_id, t1.team_id, t1.inspection_quantity, t1.totalWage, mbw.name AS workshop_name, mbp.name AS process_name, mbtul.user_name AS team_leader_user_name, mbp.product_type FROM ( SELECT myc.workshop_id, myc.process_id, myc.team_id, SUM(IFNULL(mbptr.inspection_quantity, 0)) AS inspection_quantity, SUM(myc.wage) AS totalWage FROM mes_yield_confirm myc LEFT JOIN mes_building_produce_team_report mbptr ON mbptr.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mbptr.id = myc.produce_team_report_id WHERE myc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE
AND myc.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND date_format(myc.reporting_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(#{selectedDate}, '%Y-%m')
GROUP BY myc.workshop_id, myc.process_id, myc.team_id ) t1 LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop mbw ON mbw.id = t1.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON t1.process_id = mbp.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link mbtul ON mbtul.team_id = t1.team_id AND mbtul.bool_leader_enum = 1 AND mbtul.bool_delete_enum = FALSE

SELECT myc.*, cp.name AS project_name, cp.serial_number AS project_serial_number, pm.name AS monomer_name, pa.name AS area_name,
CASE myc.product_type WHEN 8 THEN tsp.specification ELSE tp.specification END AS product_specification, CASE myc.product_type WHEN 8 THEN tsp.name ELSE tp.name END AS product_name, CASE myc.product_type WHEN 8 THEN mcpbsl.type ELSE mcpwc.type_name END AS type_name,
tp.specification AS product_specification, tsp.name AS product_name, mcpwc.type_name AS type_name,
tp.serial_number AS product_serial_number FROM mes_yield_confirm myc LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = myc.contract_project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.id = myc.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area pa ON pa.id = myc.area_id
LEFT JOIN (select mcpawcl.id, mac.classification as type_name FROM mes_contract_project_assembling_welding_config_link mcpawcl LEFT JOIN mes_artifact_classification mac ON mac.id = mcpawcl.artifact_classification_id WHERE mcpawcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE) mcpwc ON mcpwc.id = myc.contract_project_wage_config_id and myc.product_type = 2 LEFT JOIN tech_artifact as tp ON tp.id = myc.product_id and myc.product_type = 2 LEFT JOIN mes_contract_project_bolt_sleeve_link mcpbsl on mcpbsl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE and mcpbsl.id = myc.contract_project_wage_config_id and myc.product_type = 8 left join tech_standard_part tsp on tsp.id = myc.product_id and myc.product_type = 8
LEFT JOIN (select mcpgwcl.id, sac.name as type_name from mes_contract_project_group_welding_config_link mcpgwcl LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_config sac ON sac.id = mcpgwcl.assemble_config_id WHERE mcpgwcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE) mcpwc ON mcpwc.id = myc.contract_project_wage_config_id LEFT JOIN tech_assemble as tp ON tp.id = myc.product_id
LEFT JOIN (select mcplocl.id, ssc.name as type_name FROM mes_contract_project_laying_off_config_link mcplocl LEFT JOIN sys_steel_classification ssc ON ssc.id = mcplocl.steel_classification_id WHERE mcplocl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE) mcpwc ON mcpwc.id = myc.contract_project_wage_config_id LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part as tp ON tp.id = myc.product_id
WHERE myc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE
AND myc.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND myc.process_id = #{processId}
AND myc.team_id = #{teamId}
AND date_format(myc.reporting_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(#{selectedDate}, '%Y-%m')
AND (cp.name LIKE #{projectNameLike} or cp.serial_number LIKE #{projectNameLike})
AND tp.serial_number LIKE #{productSerialNumberLike}

SELECT myc.*, cp.name AS project_name, cp.serial_number AS project_serial_number, pm.name AS monomer_name, pa.name AS area_name,
CASE myc.product_type WHEN 8 THEN tsp.specification ELSE tp.specification END AS product_specification, CASE myc.product_type WHEN 8 THEN tsp.name ELSE tp.name END AS product_name, CASE myc.product_type WHEN 8 THEN mcpbsl.type ELSE mcpwc.type_name END AS type_name,
tp.specification AS product_specification, tp.name AS product_name, mcpwc.type_name AS type_name,
tp.serial_number AS product_serial_number FROM mes_yield_confirm myc LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = myc.contract_project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.id = myc.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area pa ON pa.id = myc.area_id
LEFT JOIN (select mcpawcl.id, mac.classification as type_name FROM mes_assembling_welding_config mcpawcl LEFT JOIN mes_artifact_classification mac ON mac.id = mcpawcl.artifact_classification_id and mac.bool_delete_enum = FALSE WHERE mcpawcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE) mcpwc ON mcpwc.id = myc.contract_project_wage_config_id and myc.product_type = 2 LEFT JOIN tech_artifact as tp ON tp.id = myc.product_id and myc.product_type = 2 and tp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_bolt_sleeve mcpbsl on mcpbsl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE and mcpbsl.id = myc.contract_project_wage_config_id and myc.product_type = 8 left join tech_standard_part tsp on tsp.id = myc.product_id and myc.product_type = 8
LEFT JOIN (select mcpgwcl.id, sac.name as type_name from mes_group_welding_config mcpgwcl LEFT JOIN sys_assemble_config sac ON sac.id = mcpgwcl.assemble_config_id and sac.bool_delete_enum = FALSE WHERE mcpgwcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE) mcpwc ON mcpwc.id = myc.contract_project_wage_config_id LEFT JOIN tech_assemble as tp ON tp.id = myc.product_id and tp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE
LEFT JOIN (select mcplocl.id, ssc.name as type_name FROM mes_contract_project_laying_off_config_link mcplocl LEFT JOIN sys_steel_classification ssc ON ssc.id = mcplocl.steel_classification_id and ssc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE WHERE mcplocl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE) mcpwc ON mcpwc.id = myc.contract_project_wage_config_id LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part as tp ON tp.id = myc.product_id and tp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE
WHERE myc.bool_delete_enum = FALSE
AND myc.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND myc.process_id = #{processId}
AND myc.team_id = #{teamId}
AND date_format(myc.reporting_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(#{selectedDate}, '%Y-%m')
AND (cp.name LIKE #{projectNameLike} or cp.serial_number LIKE #{projectNameLike})
AND tp.serial_number LIKE #{productSerialNumberLike}

SELECT lt.current_month as month_value, mcpoal.type as typeName, SUM(lt.totalNetWeight * IFNULL(mcpoal.price, 0)) AS cost FROM mes_contract_project_other_apportionment_link mcpoal LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MONTH(mbptr.create_time) AS current_month, mbptr.process_id AS processId, ta.project_id AS projectId, SUM(IFNULL(mbptr.inspection_quantity, 0) * IFNULL(ta.net_weight, 0) / 1000) AS totalNetWeight FROM mes_building_produce_team_report mbptr LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = mbptr.product_id WHERE mbptr.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mbptr.task_type_enum = 2 AND YEAR (mbptr.create_time) = #{year} GROUP BY current_month, ta.project_id, mbptr.process_id ) lt ON lt.processId = mcpoal.process_id AND lt.projectId = mcpoal.contract_project_id WHERE mcpoal.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND mcpoal.status = true GROUP BY lt.current_month, mcpoal.type
